articles.summary: Builders FirstSource, Inc. (NYSE: BLDR) (“Builders FirstSource” or the “Company”) is hosting its 2026 Investor Day and webcast today at the New York Stock Exchange. Presentations begin at 8:45 a.m. Eastern Time and are expected to conclude at approximately 12:00 p.m. Chief Executive Officer Peter Jackson, Chief Financial Officer Pete Beckmann, and members of the senior leadership team will present a detailed overview of the Company’s growth strategy, operational, digital and technology initiatives, capital allocation framework, and long-term financial targets. The event will also include two QA sessions with senior leadership. The live webcast and presentation materials will be available to the public on the Company’s investor relations website at investors.bldr.com under the Events and Presentations section. An archived replay will be available within 24 hours following the event’s conclusion and will remain accessible for approximately 90 days. About Builders FirstSource
articles.title: Builders FirstSource Hosts 2026 Investor Day
